_comment: Traducao para ingles das descricoes dos repositorios. O portugues vem do campo `description` no proprio GitHub; aqui fica so o ingles, uma vez. Chave = nome do repositorio. Repo sem entrada aqui cai na descricao do GitHub, entao esquecer de traduzir degrada, nao quebra. Consumido pelo site (useGitHubProjects) e pelo gerador do README do perfil (atualizar_perfil.sh).
project-operations-dashboard: Collaborative kanban with workspaces, invites and role-based permissions — the rules live in the database as RLS, not in a middleware a direct call could skip
worldscape-clicker: Online co-op clicker with authoritative server state and a planet rendered on a 3D globe
uno-online: UNO card game with online multiplayer: lobby, room codes, waiting room and a live table
portfolio-3d: Personal portfolio built around a 3D scene, with projects, blog, about and contact
jarvis-ai-system: Command center for automation agents — seven interface screens
whatsapp-stock-bot: Inventory control driven by WhatsApp messages, with an Excel workbook as the source of truth
invoice-pdf-to-excel: Pulls invoices and bank statements out of PDF into Excel, then files the documents by issuer and date
exceljs-styling: Spreadsheet generation with per-cell control: fonts, fills, borders, alignment, formulas and merged headers
floating-clock: Always-on-top desktop clock with timezone support
minecraft-handcuff-mod: Handcuff mod for Minecraft, with original models and animations authored in Blockbench
javascript-freecodecamp: Solutions to the freeCodeCamp algorithms and data structures challenges
todo-mvc-mongodb: REST API for tasks in MVC architecture, with authentication, seeders, tests and Docker
time-tracker: Work-hour logging backed by a local SQLite database
marketplace-fullstack: Specification for a fullstack marketplace: catalog, search, cart, orders and admin
enterprise-api: Specification for a professional-grade REST API — no interface, backend only
